description: This file defines the implementation of a system target in Orleans for managing and canceling grain calls remotely. It includes interfaces, data structures, and the main class 'GrainCallCancellationManager' that handles cancellation requests, manages workers for communication with other silos, and processes cluster membership updates.

classes.name: IGrainCallCancellationManagerSystemTarget
classes.description: Interface for a system target that handles cancellation of grain calls remotely.

classes.name: GrainCallCancellationRequest
classes.description: A serializable data structure representing a request to cancel a specific grain call, including target and source grain IDs and message ID.

classes.name: GrainCallCancellationManager
classes.description: Main class implementing remote management of grain call cancellations, handling both local requests and communication with other silos, including cluster membership monitoring.

methods.name: CancelCallsAsync
methods.description: Handles incoming cancellation requests by directly invoking cancellation extensions locally or via remote grain calls.

methods.name: SignalCancellation
methods.description: Signals a cancellation request to a specific silo and grain, enqueuing it for processing.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Continuously monitors cluster membership changes for detecting dead silos and cleaning up associated resources.

methods.name: PumpCancellationQueue
methods.description: Background task that batches and sends cancellation requests to remote silos.

methods.name: GetOrCreateWorker
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a worker responsible for communicating with a specific silo.

methods.name: RemoveWorker
methods.description: Removes and disposes of a worker for a specific silo.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Initialization routine for the manager (empty in this implementation).

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Performs cleanup and shutdown procedures for the manager, cancelling workers and stopping background tasks.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the manager to the silo lifecycle events for startup and shutdown handling.
